decisions.rationale: Ansible-created Keycloak postgres without ownerRef. No controller manages it. Attribution gap — in keycloak namespace (rhbk-operator footprint) but no label/ownerRef evidence. Config explicit_delete via configs/full-teardown.json under rhbk-operator.
decisions.recovery_note: PVCs retained by config (not deleted). Ansible --tags keycloak for re-deploy after operator restore. If PVCs are manually deleted, stale credentials require full keycloak re-deploy.
